camera_continuity: The exact same linked perspective camera and all static shared geometry are used in both scenes.
foreground_occlusion_guidance: Laptop top bezel starts around y987. Keep the character torso behind the laptop silhouette; layer independently gesturing hands in front when desired. The laptop screen quad is recorded in plate_composition.json.
initial_failed_attempt: First v001 and first v003 OptiX subprocesses each exited with a GPU misaligned-address error before producing plates. A clean subprocess retry succeeded with the same settings and no CPU fallback each time. Failed-attempt render elapsed was not instrumented.
limitations: This records background-only visual inspection. Character placement, lipsync, screen overlays, captions, audio and the final animated composite must be inspected separately. The static plate images include the display transform; avoid applying AgX a second time in compositing.
